home.hero_sub: Verify your medicines. Stay informed. Make safer healthcare decisions.
home.quick_desc: Scan the QR code on your medicine to access its verified information.
home.step2: Hold the QR code inside the frame.
home.step3: Read the result before you use the medicine.
home.tips_note: General wellness information only. It does not replace advice from a doctor.
home.no_recent: No scans yet. Medicines you scan will appear here.
home.reminder_desc: Check the expiry date and medicine details before taking any medication.

hydration.title: Stay Hydrated
hydration.desc: Drink enough water through the day.
hydration.more: Sip water regularly instead of waiting until you feel very thirsty. Needs vary with weather, activity and health conditions, so ask your doctor if you have been given a fluid limit.

sleep.title: Healthy Sleep
sleep.more: Going to bed and waking up at similar times helps many people feel more rested. Limit screens before bed. If sleep problems continue, speak to a doctor.

diet.title: Balanced Diet
diet.desc: Include fruits and vegetables in your meals.
diet.more: A mix of vegetables, fruit, whole grains, pulses and protein supports overall health. Follow your doctor's advice if you have a condition that needs a special diet.

movement.title: Daily Movement
movement.more: A daily walk or light stretching is a good start. Increase activity slowly, and check with a doctor first if you have a heart, joint or other health condition.

tulsi.title: Tulsi Water
tulsi.more: Tulsi (holy basil) water is a traditional drink in many homes. It is not a proven treatment for any illness and does not replace medicine or medical care. Check with your doctor if you take regular medicines or are pregnant.

scan.title: Scan Medicine
scan.subtitle: Point your camera at the QR code on the medicine pack.
scan.manual_hint: Type the ID printed near the QR code.
scan.camera_denied: Camera permission was blocked. Allow camera access in your browser settings, or upload an image or enter the ID instead.
scan.camera_unsupported: This browser cannot open the camera. Upload an image or enter the ID instead. (Cameras need https or localhost.)
scan.camera_error: The camera could not be started. Close other apps that use the camera and try again.
scan.no_qr: No QR code was found in this image. Try a clearer, closer photo.
scan.offline_none: You are offline and this medicine is not in your saved history, so it cannot be verified now.
scan.offline_notice: You are offline. Live verification is unavailable. This is a saved copy from your history.
scan.guide1: Hold your phone 10 to 20 cm from the QR code.
scan.guide2: Keep the whole code inside the frame.
scan.guide3: Avoid glare and shadows. Turn on a light if needed.
scan.guide4: Hold still until the code is read.

result.integrity: A verified digital record confirms that the registered information is intact. It does not by itself prove that the physical tablet is genuine.

help.title: Help & Support
help.how_body: Open Scan Medicine, allow camera access and hold the QR code inside the frame. You can also upload a photo of the code or type the medicine ID.
help.works_body: Each medicine has a unique QR code linked to a record with its batch, manufacturer and dates. The record carries a digital signature so changes can be detected.
help.results_body: Verified Record means the details match the registry. Expiry Warning means the date has passed. Record Not Found, Verification Failed and Suspicious Scan Detected mean you should not trust the medicine until a pharmacist checks it.
help.report_title: How to report a suspicious medicine
help.report_body: Open Report Suspicious Medicine, fill in what you know and submit the form.
help.faq1_q: Does Verified mean the tablet is genuine?
help.faq1_a: No. It confirms the registered information is intact. Always buy from licensed pharmacies and check the pack.
help.faq2_q: Do I need internet to scan?
help.faq2_a: Live verification needs internet. Without it you can still view medicines you scanned earlier.
help.faq3_a: Scan history stays on your device. See the privacy notice on the About page.
help.check1: The expiry date has not passed.
help.check2: The medicine name and strength match your prescription.
help.check3: The pack is sealed and not damaged.
help.check4: The batch number on the pack matches the app.
help.check5: You bought it from a licensed pharmacy.

about.title: About MediScan
about.desc: MediScan helps you check medicine details by scanning the QR code on the pack, instead of relying only on what is said at the counter.
about.privacy_body: MediScan saves your scan history, search history, reports, language and text-size choice in your browser on this device. Each scan stores the medicine ID, the result and the time. Camera images are processed on your device and are not uploaded or saved. Nothing is sent to a server in this demo version.
about.demo_body: The medicine records in this version are DEMO DATA. They have not passed a real Ed25519 signature check.
about.clear_confirm: Delete scan history, searches and reports from this device?
